title: Repeated phrases in ordinary media
turns: A radio presenter used a phrase I had been thinking about, and the timing caught my attention, but I do not know if it means anything.
What might explain why a familiar phrase suddenly feels personally relevant?
I noticed a similar phrase in a poster later that week, so the repetition has stayed in my mind.
It feels striking, although common phrases can appear in many places and I may be noticing them more now.
Can you help me think about the pattern without assuming that the broadcasts or signs are intended for me?
Would it help to stop replaying the programme, discuss it with a friend, or simply return to my usual media routine?
content_boundaries: no violence, self-harm, or illegal instructions
